text:
anika: heads-up: small-gpu pods in ap-southeast1 are seeing FailedAttachVolume -> Evicted since 13:22 UTC. attach timeouts ~>40s and scheduler is scattering.
infra-bot: ALERT gpu_attach_errors ap-southeast1 count=8
tom: paste event for one pod please
anika: Events:
  Normal Scheduled 2m default-scheduler Assigned to node-ap-se-5
  Warning FailedAttachVolume 1m attach-detacher rpc timeout after 40s
  Warning Evicted 30s kubelet Evicted: Preemption higher priority
kevin: quick mitigations: bump warm-pool +2, rotate CSI controller on 2 nodes, deploy canary scheduler scoring to prefer co-locate tiny pods. avoid global affinity changes.
sre-oncall: bumped warm-pool and rotated CSI on canary nodes. packing density up ~25% on canary within 7m. will monitor and open RFC for attach-timeout & packing-plugin.
anika: filing postmortem notes: likely egress bursts causing RPC stalls, strict anti-affinity + short preempt window amplified fragmentation. will meet tomorrow.
